simple.meaning: מַסְמֵר (maçmêr) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a peg (as bristling from the surface).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 4 times in 1 Chronicles, 2 Chronicles, Isaiah, Jeremiah, beginning at 1 Chronicles 22:3. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַסְמֵר (H4548) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מַסְמֵר (maçmêr) / H4548 is traced through 1 Chronicles 22:3, 2 Chronicles 3:9, Isaiah 41:7, Jeremiah 10:4 with source-language evidence and verse context.

structuredEvidence.definition: a peg (as bristling from the surface)

firstOccurrence.englishText: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings; and bronze in abundance without weight;

timeline.evidenceText: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings; and bronze in abundance without weight;

The weight of the nails was fifty shekels‡ A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.32 Troy ounces, so 50 shekels was about 0.5 kilograms or about 16 Troy ounces. of gold. He overlaid the upper rooms with gold.
So the carpenter encourages the goldsmith.
They deck it with silver and with gold.

definitions.full: H4548. masmer or mismer or masmerah or mismerah or masmerah [ מַסְמֵר ] noun masculine Eccl 12:11 nail (connection with above √ dubious; מַסְמְרָא ᵑ7 , ChrPalAramaic Schw 63. 122 ; Late Hebrew verb סמר nail on or up ; Arabic is perhaps loan-word Frä 89 ); — plural absolute מַסְמְרִים Isa 41:7 , מִסְמְרִים 1Chr 22:3 (of iron; on ִ֯ see Ges § 85f .); also מַסְמְרוֺת Jer 10:4 (+ מַקָּבוֺת ), נְטוּעִים מַשְׂמְרוֺת , Eccl 12:11 (simile; + דָּרְבֹנוֺת ), and מִסְמְרוֺת 2Chr 3:9 (of gold). [ מַשְׂמֵר ], מַשְׂמְרוֺת , Eccl 12:14 , see [ מַסְמֵר ].
